_banner: HARNESS-ONLY SEALED TRUTH -- no SUT principal may read this document (CLAUDE.md red line 5; SS A.3). correlation_id and P_hashes are completed by the runner at mint time, because tokens are minted at run time (ADR 0007) and the correlation id is minted per invocation (SS F.1).

provenance.anchor_note: NOT anchored to RFC 9449 or to OAuth 2.1 core, both of which were opened and neither of which covers this. RFC 9449 (DPoP). Retrieved 2026-08-06 mentions audience-restricted tokens only in SS 2 as an alternative that “has proven to be prohibitively cumbersome” and mandates no resource-server audience check; OAuth 2.1 core contains no such requirement either. The covering requirement is RFC 9068's
family_properties: Acharya and Gupta, MCPShield, arXiv:2604.05969, submitted 7 April 2026: TV22 Replay Attacks (part of F3)
provenance.subcase_anchor: RFC 9068 (JWT Profile for OAuth 2.0 Access Tokens). Retrieved 2026-08-06: SS 4 `Validating JWT Access Tokens` -- “The resource server MUST validate that the `aud` claim contains a resource indicator value corresponding to an identifier the resource server expects for itself. The JWT access token MUST be rejected if `aud` does not contain a resource indicator of the current resource server as a valid audience.”
